{{Quote|First, you lose this system, and ''Grievous'' comes in and destroys my entire stronghold, leaving me here to just ''rummage'' through the leftovers of my once-great empire.|[[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="Revival (episode)">{{TCW|Revival (episode)}}</ref>}}
The '''Florrum system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]], home to the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]] of [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Florrum [[Star system/Legends|system]] was controlled by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] until around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], when [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] [[Attack on Obi-Wan Kenobi's fleet/Legends|destroyed]] a [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] commanded by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]. With Kenobi out of the way, Grievous moved into the Florrum system and captured it for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], launching an [[Invasion of Florrum/Legends|attack]] on [[Florrum/Legends|Florrum]] itself capturing the planet temporarily.
